safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports a tingling sensation around the lips.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies tingling around the lips; generated documentation mentions tingling in the throat but does not document lip tingling.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Peri-oral (lip) tingling can be a relevant early feature of an allergic reaction/anaphylaxis and helps characterize airway/oral involvement. Omitting it could slightly reduce diagnostic clarity and risk stratification, although the patient still had other concerning symptoms prompting urgent escalation.
